notes.title: June 2025 - Patch fixes
notes.content:
This are a few balance improvements :

Player balances, soccer or tennis players got stronger but jimmy slightly weaker.
Auto-fire is faster now.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update version 1.1.14b - No more tired arms! (Autofire)
notes.content:
This update is simple:

I just added auto-fire support. I got asked about that a few times I decided to add it. Mind you, it doesn't give players any additional advantage over pro-players, as fire cadency has been adjusted to each player stats.
Enable it here:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42981650/a7400a6c8f8ed6e2b410b61984fa1a9900b96fd9.jpg

NOTE:
[strike]We're considering adding autojump or autoextra-jump (when leaving pressed jump). Please let us know in discussions if you think its a good idea.[/strike] (We don't think its a good idea anymore but feel free to comment it.)

- I also added some initial fix on stage 1-1 arcade mode was not telling the player to "beat all enemies".
- There is a simple fix about extra jump.
- Also last rolling ball will get destroyed a lot earlier, this is good for some specific stages and chaos mode.

And remember since 1.1.12:
- I enabled tournaments. You can participate in free tournaments as long as you own the game.

More information here:

http://www.kaleidogames.com/tournament-slam-and-roll


This is probably the last patch, at least for a while. Have fun!

notes.title: Final Slam and Roll Update 1.1.10
notes.content:
Exciting Update: New Tweaks and Fixes for Slam and Roll!

We’ve just rolled out a fresh update with final tweaks and fixes across all platforms—Xbox, Nintendo Switch, and Steam.

To showcase these improvements, I’ve updated the store page with new screenshots and an awesome preview video that you can watch right here:
[previewyoutube=ScBDO5pXXsI;full][/previewyoutube]
New Feature: Co-op Teasing Panel

A new Versus Panel has been added, bringing dynamic and fun teasing graphics between players during co-op matches. It’s designed to spice up your co-op experience, but don’t worry—it’s completely optional if it’s not your style:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42981650/f135a45a657de133a2b46cedfb1236edbff5d7da.jpg
Fixes:
    Corrected typos across all languages.
    Streamlined menu navigation for improved clarity and usability.
    Adjusted enemy landings to ensure pixel-perfect alignment with the floor.
    Fixed missing decorative walls on the screen edges.

Enhancements:
    Stage Completion Trigger: The transition to the next stage is now faster—rolling balls will crash much earlier when no enemies remain on screen.
    New Filter: Introducing “HC+NO ZOOM” for players who prefer a more strategic, zoom-free, global view of the stage.

Gameplay Update
No significant gameplay changes were made this time. The core mechanics remain as fun and challenging as ever!

Thank you for your continued support. Get ready to experience these updates and keep rolling your way to victory! 🏀👾

notes.title: Slam and Roll 1.1.2 Welcome to Coop and Ranking in-game's instant panels
notes.content:
A week after release, I got a ton of feedback and improved the game so much.
But there is one special feature you need to check out!

Instant ranking notification on CHAOS and both ARCADE modes. 
Don't worry it's optional.

I'm so excited to show you this. It's such a neat feature! But you need to enable it in VISUAL OPTIONS if you are coming from a previous version of the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42981650/e3592a1399728679f5bccd3dc6d6a5a5fb1b5bdd.jpg

Will trigger a panel like any of these two:

Simple:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42981650/15fa464a72d9563bfd3453d14f2d6c4fa087506b.jpg

Complex:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42981650/0adaf7302876bf4e5018b1eba19c9f9fa433092d.jpg

Also a similar panel, to make co-op games a lot more fun and competitive...
Instant WIN/LOSE panel in between stages of COOP games.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42981650/546871929d7a529e5c59056f303e07ca20fad8f5.jpg

But also:
- Some level tweaks!
- No more soft locks! This means you can't get stuck anymore. Mind you, one-way platforms are still there.
- Other small fixes.


I hope you enjoy this game as much as I still do after 4 years full time development :D

See you at the leaderboards!

notes.title: Final Early Access Patch [1.1.0]
notes.content:
We have made a massive overhaul on tiles' colors and details.  The whole game looks a lot better now.


We also have unlocked all features that were locked in Early Access with the exception of Achievements! They will remain locked until release day: 14th November 2024!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Final Early Access patch!
notes.content:
Last Early Access patch:

This final patch fixes some strange errors but also adds:
- Chaos mode is more accessible now.
- 2 more leaderboards.

But also starts first Slam and Roll small contest.
Contest up to 27th October 2024, 24:00 GMT.
Top player on the  tour mode (one trip)  will get a free Nintendo Switch or XBOX key as reward for being best player. Also access to the final version (with all leaderboards and achievements) earlier than the rest of the public!

notes.title: Patch#2b - Update Announcement: Exciting new features, fixes and visuals!
notes.content:
We added a couple of small fixes and visual enhancements.

Features from patch#2:

 Full support for STEAM DECK.
 Some new reworked stages.
 Fixes for some bosses.
 Chaos mode is now a bit more accessible.
 Various world tile-sets + backgrounds have been enhanced.
 Bug fixes for rare occurrences (thanks for finding them: Pomez).
 Final translation for all supported languages.
 An extra credit is now added permanently to "game arcade credits" every 3 new characters unlocked.


Also added in this patch #2b:

 New awesome graphic effects
 New balanced gameplay and other small stage fixes.
 German language tweaks.
